# Compiled system-call coverage investigation

Follow-up to user request for zero interpreted instructions on both measured games.
Do not substitute coverage counts for correctness or speed.

The current V20e census leaves mostly SWI and the following BX/LDR instructions.
A system call always requires the kernel handler even when guest decoding and
control flow are compiled. Candidate design: generated ARM/Thumb SVC evaluates
its predicate, advances PC and returns a typed pending-trap descriptor through
existing aot_exit. The outer execution loop performs the same kernel operation
at its exact cumulative guest instruction count. No syscall-number/game rule.

Requirements before implementation acceptance:
- Preserve native NumInstrsToExecute subtraction using the total instructions
  executed in the outer run, including this SVC; do not substitute per-block
  counts or original remaining budget.
- Publish packed flags before kernel invocation; reload split flags afterward.
- Clear exclusive reservations after the kernel callback, including other cores.
- Kernel may change registers, flags, PC, instruction count, mapping or IRQ.
- An unchanged PC falls through without inserting an IRQ check. A changed PC
  takes the existing DISPATCH path. Page-ending instructions dispatch too.
- Preserve conditional SVC false behavior: no kernel call or monitor clear.
- Resume compiled lookup on ordinary fallthrough so return instructions can
  compile, retaining mapping/lifetime validation. Avoid relabeling interpreter
  execution as compiled.
- Rare mode changes without a PC change and previously cached SINGLE_STEP
  translations require explicit treatment; do not assume the game never uses
  them. Native tests must include short budgets and callback budget increases.
- Checked replay must compare pre-kernel state without replaying real kernel
  side effects. A reference handler can capture the expected trap and reservation
  before the native reference clears it; separate real native probes verify
  actual callback behavior and continuation.
- Native probe: ARM/Thumb, all predicates, flag prefixes, instruction count,
  positive/zero budget changes, IRQ, PC/mode change, page ends, reservation state,
  memory/remap, repeated SVC and return; on/off paths and both execution modes.
- Full compiler suite, native package targets and both games exact image/record/
  PCM replays, then fresh fallback census and serial paired timings.

This is design work only. No SVC implementation is selected or deployed.
